questions.q: Which of the following statements correctly distinguishes a **Joint Venture** from a **Partnership**?
options: A joint venture is formed for an indefinite duration, whereas a partnership is strictly short-term
A joint venture is a temporary business combination formed for a specific contract or project and dissolves upon its completion, whereas a partnership is an ongoing business relationship
Co-venturers are personally liable for all personal lifetime debts of other venturers, unlike partners in a partnership
A joint venture requires mandatory incorporation under the Companies Act, while a partnership does not
questions.explain: A **Joint Venture** is a temporary partnership entered into by two or more persons (or entities) to undertake a specific, limited business project (such as underwriting an issue of shares or building a bridge). Once the project is concluded, the joint venture terminates automatically without formal legal dissolution proceedings.

questions.q: What is the primary function of preparing a **Memorandum Joint Venture Account** when co-venturers maintain records of joint venture transactions in their individual ledgers?
options: To record only the initial cash contributions made by the lead venturer
To combine all the transactions recorded by the different co-venturers in order to calculate the overall net profit or loss of the venture
To serve as a legal Balance Sheet presented to external financial institutions
To record the settlement of individual personal drawings made by each co-venturer
questions.explain: A **Memorandum Joint Venture Account** is not part of the double-entry ledger of any single venturer. It is a combined memorandum (summary) account prepared by pulling together all revenues and expenses incurred by all co-venturers to determine the total net profit or loss of the joint venture, which is subsequently shared among them according to their agreed profit-sharing ratio.
